name: Bear
summary: Standing upright, with flowers painted across the chest.
text:
Standing straight, paws at its sides, a spray of flowers painted on its chest. Tall and narrow, in white, with very simple lines.

There is also a dark wood version with a pale chest — tell us which you would like.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
